facts.fact: Popmyday states that its Popartist hairdressers travel to clients 7 days a week and until 22:00 in the evening.
facts.unit: days per week; latest time of visit
facts.quote: Ils se déplacent 7/7 jours et jusqu’à 22:00 le soir

facts.fact: Popmyday states that its home hairdressers travel to the following towns: Paris, Boulogne, Levallois, Clichy, Aubervilliers, Pantin, Montreuil, Vincennes, Ivry, Montrouge, Saint-Cloud and Neuilly.
facts.quote: Nos coiffeurs privés se déplacent dans les villes suivantes :

facts.fact: Popmyday states that its Popartists are beauty professionals who are used to working at clients' homes.
facts.quote: Nos Popartistes sont des professionnels de la beauté habitués à exercer à domicile

facts.fact: Popmyday states that its home hairdressers offer a diagnosis of the client's hair as part of the service.
facts.quote: vous proposeront un diagnostic de votre chevelure
